command: import json, urllib.request; base="http://127.0.0.1:8003"; get=lambda path: json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(base+path)); before=get("/api/v1/status"); paths=["/rankings", "/compare?app_ids=570", "/api/v1/apps?scope=catalog", "/api/v1/rankings", "/api/v1/compare?app_ids=570"]; statuses={path: urllib.request.urlopen(base+path).status for path in paths}; comparison=get("/api/v1/compare?app_ids=570"); after=get("/api/v1/status"); assert all(status==200 for status in statuses.values()); assert before["total_observations"]==after["total_observations"]==0; assert after["schedule_state"]=="disabled"; assert comparison["series"][0]["availability"]=="no_observations"; print(json.dumps({"status":"passed", "url":base, "responses":statuses, "observations_before":before["total_observations"], "observations_after":after["total_observations"], "schedule_state":after["schedule_state"], "comparison_points":comparison["returned_points"]}, indent=2))
